GUI.note:
Assessment
Darren Kutch (DOB 2001-12-10, MRN SYN-4250778) is a 22-year-old male presenting with persistent, severe generalized pruritus and secondary excoriations/prurigo-like papules refractory to two properly administered courses of topical permethrin 5% cream (February and March 2024) and daily cetirizine 10 mg.

1. Scabies Evaluation: Scabies is no longer a likely explanation. The patient completed two full courses of permethrin 5% (applied neck to toes with 7-day repeat and hot-water laundering), close contacts (partner, coworkers, family) remain completely asymptomatic, web spaces and genitals are spared, dermoscopy showed no burrows, and mineral oil skin scrapings from four sites were negative for mites, eggs, or feces. Skin findings represent secondary excoriations and prurigo-like papules from scratching rather than a primary ectoparasitic eruption.
